tooltip.paradigm.smileynotes.tooltip: Notes from the God of the Afterlife and Dead, unknown if they work still.
tooltip.paradigm.semigodeffigy.tooltip: A strange item. It doesn't work like the other Effigies.
tooltip.paradigm.demigodeffigy.tooltip: A weakened version of the relic that is next to come.
tooltip.paradigm.afterlifeeffigy.tooltip: Fueled by the power of a entity not of this sector, it opens the Gateway.
tooltip.paradigm.godeffigy.tooltip: The accumulation of true power. A truly powerful Relic. It floods the mind of anyone who holds it with confidence.
tooltip.paradigm.jadeeffigy.tooltip: Created by combining the powers of Gods and Deco, a cumulation of two parts of the world.
tooltip.paradigm.souleffigy.tooltip: Created with the intent of the Soul in mind, carrying it increases the soul energy of the holder.
tooltip.paradigm.emptyeffigy.tooltip: Blank and ready to get powered into the next stage.
tooltip.paradigm.emptydemieffigy.tooltip: In order to get charged you must gather a number of Beacon or Spawner Blocks.
tooltip.paradigm.emptysemieffigy.tooltip: In order to get charged you must collect a number of Conduits, Netherite Blocks, or Enchanting Tables.
tooltip.paradigm.emptyafterlifeeffigy.to: In order to get charged you must collect a number of Bone Blocks.
tooltip.paradigm.emptyjadeeffigy.tooltip: In order to get charged you must collect a number of Jade Blocks.
tooltip.paradigm.emptysouleffigy.tooltip: In order to get charged you must collect a number of Sculk and Soul Related Blocks.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_empty_soul_effi: The Charged and near complete form of the Soul Effigy.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_empty_demi_effi: The Charged and near complete form of the Demigod Effigy.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_empty_jade_effi: The Charged and near complete form of the Jade Effigy.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_empty_semi_effi: The Charged and near complete form of the Semigod Effigy.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_empty_afterlife: The Charged and near complete form of the Afterlife Effigy.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_empty_solar_eff: The Charged and near complete form of the Solar Effigy.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_empty_lunar_eff: The Charged and near complete form of the Lunar Effigy.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_empty_esoteric_: The Charged and near complete form of the Esoteric Effigy.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_empty_reverence: The Charged and near complete form of the Reverence Effigy.
tooltip.paradigm.base_inverted_weapon.to: Forged to conquer the soul, this is a weapon that exceeds Mortal Limits.
tooltip.paradigm.smiley_inverted.tooltip: The first mortal made god weapon. An Inverted Weapon that was made out of divine metal. Along with being powered by 2 souls, it has the ability to make the wielder immortal. For a price of course...
tooltip.paradigm.solareffigy.tooltip: The power of the sun. In the palm of your hands.
tooltip.paradigm.lunareffigy.tooltip: The power of the moon. In the palm of your hands.
tooltip.paradigm.eclipseeffigy.tooltip: The power of the Eclipse... a dangerous tool.
tooltip.paradigm.bindment_book.tooltip: Holding this book it appears to be binded to one of the gods.
tooltip.paradigm.divinity_favor.tooltip: The accumulation of all Divine Favors, both God and Demigod.
tooltip.paradigm.effigy_extract.tooltip: The latent powers of every Lesser Effigy put into one that is the accumulation of all.
tooltip.paradigm.effigy_core.tooltip: It seems to be powerless... maybe it needs more?
tooltip.paradigm.markarchitect.tooltip: An item recognized by the Architect of Creation itself.
sounds.paradigm.transmutation: The world has been graced... or forsaken.
tooltip.paradigm.cooking_knife.tooltip: A cooking tool needed in every kitchen, and wanted by every chef.
tooltip.paradigm.fragmented_icon.tooltip: A lesser recollection of weapons put together to form the closest to a God Weapon.
tooltip.paradigm.dark_bindment.tooltip: A spectacular weapon from another world from unknown origin.
tooltip.paradigm.base_god_weapon.tooltip: A weapon from the gods and channeling their energies.
tooltip.paradigm.unknown_mask.tooltip: A mask dedicated to the Seventh God and channeling mystical energy.
tooltip.paradigm.demigod_favor.tooltip: This favor channels the energy of every Demigod, treat it with care.
tooltip.paradigm.god_favor.tooltip: This favor channels the energy of every God, treat it with care.
tooltip.paradigm.favor.tooltip: It channels the energy of one of the divines.
tooltip.paradigm.blank_favor.tooltip: Waiting to resonate with one of the Divines.
tooltip.paradigm.tp_item.tooltip: Sneak + Right Click to save a location
tooltip.paradigm.tp_item_line_2.tooltip: Right Click to TP to that location in your dimension.
tooltip.paradigm.phoenixgrail.tooltip: Fueld by the power of the Phoenix, it will benefit all who hold it.
tooltip.paradigm.dragonhorn.tooltip: Manifesting the power of the Dragons, this calls upon their breath.
tooltip.paradigm.thundersprite.tooltip: Charged with the pure electric energy of Zapa, it will strike your foes.
tooltip.paradigm.healing_touch.tooltip: Some say that when it's held those around yourself will find themselves feeling better.
tooltip.paradigm.chaos_mark.tooltip: Chaotic forces run through any who try and hold this elegant source.
tooltip.paradigm.reverenceeffigy.tooltip: The fueling power of Reverence put into an Effigy. Can you eat it?
tooltip.paradigm.jade_heart.tooltip: Scholars debate whether this is the Heart of Deco, or just a worthless relic.
tooltip.paradigm.sep.tooltip: Inside is held the Soul-Engraved Power of a soul.
tooltip.paradigm.soul.tooltip: Inside is held the soul of what was once a living thing.
tooltip.paradigm.soul_extracter.tooltip: A powerful tool used in Loop 4 to forcefully extract a targets soul.
tooltip.paradigm.inverted_dagger.tooltip: The smallest Inverted Weapon, though do not underestimate its capabilities.
tooltip.paradigm.inverted_blade.tooltip: The simplest of the Inverted Weapons. Though it doesn't mean it is simple to understand.
tooltip.paradigm.inverted_brand.tooltip: Built with lengthy conflicts in mind. One of the most dangerous Inverted Weapons. Be careful who you use it on.
tooltip.paradigm.inverted_bite.tooltip: The Inverted Weapon that has the capability of poisoning whoever it strikes. A dangerous tool to kill both soul and body.
tooltip.paradigm.inverted_hammer.tooltip: The heaviest of the Inverted Weapons. Has the ability to cause shockwaves where it strikes. Be careful with it.
tooltip.paradigm.inverted_cutter.tooltip: The most mechanical out of all of the Inverted Weapons. Once it spun at the speed of sound. Though now its just a dual blade.
tooltip.paradigm.inverted_spear.tooltip: An Inverted Weapon once thrown by The Soulsmith himself. Though it never returns to anyone. Excluding him.
tooltip.paradigm.inverted_divider.toolti: Something that attacks the heart and soul of an individual. Handle it with care.
tooltip.paradigm.soul_inversion.tooltip: The Inverted Weapon that was once named his Perfect Creation, has the unique ability of inverting the positive effects and SEP effects of whoever it strikes. Truly something to admire.
tooltip.paradigm.effigy_extractor.toolti: A strange item that seems to have no use... but it resonates with the Effigies.
tooltip.paradigm.gilden_blade.tooltip: A shattered blade created for speed and efficiency.
tooltip.paradigm.charged_heart.tooltip: A weapon once crafted by the Late God of Items, and now reconstructed to reinstate fear.
tooltip.paradigm.skull_scythe.tooltip: A weapon crafted to show the insecurities and weakness of the Living World.
tooltip.paradigm.everlasting_grace.toolt: Blessed by Astral herself, this item will bring about life to even the harshest of deserts.
tooltip.paradigm.stillchain.tooltip: Using the power of Ismene it will cause any and all others to freeze.
tooltip.paradigm.winged_grace.tooltip: Fueled the power of a distant land, it will protect any who hold it from the fall.
tooltip.paradigm.minor_stillchain.toolti: A minor version of Ismene's true power.
tooltip.paradigm.pumpking.tooltip: A splinter of Mr. Pumpkin's amount of hatred.
tooltip.paradigm.demigod_remains.tooltip: The remains of what was before. Be careful holding this ancient relic.
tooltip.paradigm.moon_shard.tooltip: Said to be a shard of the moon itself, these parts have fallen down to the planet since.
tooltip.paradigm.sun_shard.tooltip: Said to be a shard of the sun itself, these parts have fallen down to the planet since.
tooltip.paradigm.eclipse_shard.tooltip: A piece of what happens when the Moon and Sun cross.
tooltip.paradigm.eldritchrite.tooltip: Holding this means you are a bearer of Eldritch Magic, the Magic of the Gods.
tooltip.paradigm.esoteric_core.tooltip: Some say that Tinal-Goh dropped this, some say another from a distant world gave it.
tooltip.paradigm.reverenceidol.tooltip: A fragment of what is to come from this artifacts existence.
tooltip.paradigm.semisparks.tooltip: Some say that the first Semigod created this item, while others say that Atlas forsook the world with it.
tooltip.paradigm.deathtotem.tooltip: A totem dedicated to the worship of the Eighth God. Smiley, the God of Death and The Afterlife.
tooltip.paradigm.crucified_bone.tooltip: Some say that this item is made from the bones of the long departed. Nobody knows where they come from.
tooltip.paradigm.atlaswrath.tooltip: A seemingly innocent weapon... maybe it holds some potential.
tooltip.paradigm.gerolust.tooltip: A dangerous weapon, any who cross it's path should cower in fear.
tooltip.paradigm.geroscar.tooltip: Looks to be an innocent looking axe.
tooltip.paradigm.gildenheart.tooltip: Fueld by the power of the Gilden God, it can push away all in it's wake.
